title: Istanbul-based TaleMonster Games, the studio behind the puzzle game Match Valley, raised a $30M Series A led by Arcadia Gaming Partners and a16z (Tamara Djurickovic/Tech.eu)
summary: Tamara Djurickovic / Tech.eu: Istanbul-based TaleMonster Games, the studio behind the puzzle game Match Valley, raised a $30M Series A led by Arcadia Gaming Partners and a16z — The mobile game studio behind the innovative puzzle title Match Valley will use the new investment to scale its category-creating casual game.
